text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—The dream of the Satono family: To 
produce a legendary Umamusume capable of 
winning a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To become that "renowned Umamusume," I 
have continued running since my youth.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved a GⅠ victory in the 
Twinkle Series, the challenge we take on 
today is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Predecessors of "great Umamusume." Two 
whom I admire, and today, my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And also...—ever since we met, you have 
always been by my side.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Run ahead of me. Even if the races we run 
and the goals we chase are different.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the same turf as the figures I 
dreamed of and admired before entering 
Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been competing with 
Kita-chan, I was able to make it all the 
way here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even so, only one can claim the crown of 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not to Kita-chan! Not to McQueen-san! Not 
to Teio-san! I won't lose to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll win and make my family's dream, my 
dream, come true!!
